description.value: You know exactly where flesh ends and the mount begins on an augmented patient. When you Treat Wounds on a creature with cybernetic augmentation, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check, and a critical failure never damages the augmentation itself.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 circumstance bonus This needs a target:trait predicate (real shape confirmed via pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/skill/level-3/aurochs-headed.json's target:trait:orc), but no Cinderfall augmentation grants its wearer an actor-level trait for that predicate to read -- installed augmentations are items, not creature traits (confirmed absent corpus-wide during the archetype pass). The critical-failure protection ('never damages the augmentation') also has no hook -- the engine doesn't track that an augmentation is at risk from a failed Treat Wounds check.
